research_question: Does the frozen original Q-RMEA simultaneously preserve correct relation decisions under semantically certified renaming and respond correctly to certified relation-changing context, accounting for both weight and utility paths?
prerequisites: Semantic certification before any outputs are observed. Source-only audit is complete; actual sample selection has not run.

Reuse one immutable original selected Q-RMEA checkpoint and exact source/encoder provenance only after availability and owner-project binding check; do not substitute the later fusion model or inherit old formal source identity from a diagnostic mirror.
No real encoder/model forward before exact source/contract independent review, scheduler allocation and cgroup/asset preflight.
No formal new-study promotion before dataset qualification and completed common-protocol baseline comparison.

sample_policy.selection: Before predictions, sort original train IDs by SHA256(UTF8 id); inspect the first32records. At most16base records may be certified. Never enlarge the pool because outputs disappoint.
sample_policy.certification: Record every inspected base as retained/rejected with reason before any model call. Labels are annotation targets, never encoder features. Semantic uncertainty, inadequate relation definitions, ambiguous coreference, or unsupported alignment rejects a proposed transformation; no forced assignments.
sample_policy.coverage: Report actual relations/coreference/role categories and all rejection counts; no minimum class coverage or population inference promised.

contrasts.name: relation_preserving_rename
requirements: Preserve ordered roles and all evidence expressing the relation.
Rename consistently across all mentions certified to refer to each same entity; preserve pronominal compatibility, alias identity, grammatical information and relevant world knowledge.
Type agreement alone is insufficient; original type fields are not a correctness oracle.
For wordwise decomposition use same word count and a verified original-to-variant word-position alignment; changed subword counts alone do not invalidate word alignment.

contrasts.name: relation_changing_context
requirements: Keep entity identities and ordered roles while deliberately changing one relation-defining cue when the applicable label guideline justifies a distinct label.
Resolve both original and modified labels before predictions; reject cases where both relations remain true or the label is ambiguous.
Do not presume that every source record permits this edit. Logit/decision checks remain possible if word alignment is unavailable, but path decomposition is marked not_applicable.
contrasts.target: An independently certified distinct relation label

observations: Reencode each complete marked input with frozen encoder. Cached original h alone cannot simulate these counterfactuals.
Record all40class logits, original/variant decisions and certified-label correctness privately; compact reports only on Git.
For aligned words record prepared density-state differences, alpha and token utilities; no global phase comparison of state vectors.
At same checkpoint fixed bias, account delta_z via sum(delta_alpha*(u_prime+u)/2)+sum((alpha_prime+alpha)/2*delta_u). This known identity is descriptive and does not identify causal mediation.
Retain all certified cases and both successful/adverse/no-change outputs; no outcome-selected case promotion.
control_boundary: For any comparative utility claim require a learned classical/matched control with the same full input transformations and trace observations. A later lambda-disabled fusion checkpoint is not automatically an original Q-RMEA matched control. The first proposed probe can only diagnose the frozen original, not establish superiority.
success_gate: Diagnostic interpretability only: actual semantic certificates and provenance pass, both contrast types exist, and both complete-decision correctness and state/weight/utility paths can be reported without outcome filtering. No numeric success rate is a L5 promotion gate.
kill_criteria: No independently defensible semantic certificates in the frozen pool: stop this probe design without inventing invariance.
Uncertain original checkpoint/source identity or unobserved applicable paths: evidence incomplete; no mechanism claim.
Attention stable while labels/decisions fail, or indiscriminate invariance to relation-changing controls: do not call it task-relevant robustness.
A generic input debiasing mechanism restated without substantive difference from CoRE/VIB/known invariance methods is not a new method.

budget.future_inference: At most48inputs including original bases; batch/memory only after reviewed worker and scheduler preflight. No diagnostic job is created by this design.

persistence: Code/design/source identities and compact reports Git; no new COS/checkpoint replication for this diagnostic. Existing private originals remain untouched. Raw rows/IDs/activations/logits/weights never published.
next_action: Create the output-blind training-only semantic certificate manifest under the frozen pool policy; only afterward implement and review a forward-only worker.
